title: A journey's panel: the judges and every candidate's votes
description: The rule (how many yes votes, whether there's a veto) is the journey's, in journey.toml, and a panel can't change it. Picks and close calls are computed by liner_notes.workflow.panel, never stored. Judge ids, one vote per judge per candidate and the veto holder are checked by code, since this schema can't name the keys.

public.description: Whether the votes and close-call quotes may be published. Default false: some quotes are opinions about artists.

rule.description: Only for checking: when present it must match the journey's rule.

judges.x-reply: keyed by a short judge id, like "pia": each {name, title, lens}, and "veto": true on the one judge who holds the veto

song.x-reply: the song's id when the inputs give one; otherwise leave it out and give title and artist

votes.x-reply: keyed by judge id, one for every judge: {vote: "yes" or "no", why: one line}

by.x-reply: the judge id holding the veto
